protocol.purpose: Released CT-Loss training recipe; 30-epoch seed-0 validation evaluation
choices: Original architecture, normalized FPCM and fixed-affine LayerNorm
BCE + literal soft-CTS + SEMEDA with positive coefficients
SEMEDA second hidden feature, mean absolute feature difference
ResNet50 ImageNet V2 initialization; no segmentation checkpoint initialization
Adam base LR 1e-4; segmentation head LR multiplier 10
Raw validation macro IoU scheduler and checkpoint monitor
Reported export uses epoch-30 last with full-train BatchNorm recalibration
Five-epoch SEMEDA pretraining on all 9600 training masks only
Training ceiling 120 epochs; use --stop-after-epoch 30 for reported budget
Single seed validation measurement; paper test tables are historical
